I have downloaded at least 20 pedometer apps and so far about 90% of them are completely unusable. They either 
1. Stop tracking after 2-3 thousand steps
2. You have to give your credit card number before you can access the 7 day free trial
3. Charge a hefty $40 a year to use the app.

Not you! Maipo is freeware unless the user wants advanced options and your fee is a VERY REASONABLE $2.95

I can’t pay now because I’m homeless doing best I can to survive 

However I do have one small suggestion. How about accepting bitcoin or Ethereum payments 

You should have no problem adding the receiving addresses for bitcoin or Ethereum to your description on the App Store. Then people who wanted to pay more or whatever they can could do so.

This app is worth more than $2.95 to me. When I get into an apt and have some extra $ I would gladly pay $10 for a clean app like Maipo that works as intended 

Thank you again. Yes I use crypto.
